claim: The clinic moved Rowan's appointment from Monday morning to Wednesday afternoon.
text: Scheduling notice: Rowan's 9:00 a.m. visit on Monday has been moved to Wednesday at 2:15 p.m. The clinician and location are unchanged.

claim: The foundation owns the project's trademark.
text: Infrastructure minutes: The continuous-integration jobs will move to a hosted runner next month. The release cache will remain on the existing service.

claim: The clinic expected Ana's visit to begin late.
text: Front desk note: the clinician is running about 25 minutes behind and Ana should expect a wait. The live appointment status still shows her visit as on time.

claim: People employed by companies are barred from serving on the steering committee.
text: Charter clause 4: Employment or organizational affiliation does not disqualify a candidate from the steering committee. Conflicts must instead be disclosed.

claim: Omar must fast before his appointment.
text: Omar's confirmation lists a 10:30 a.m. visit. The attached laboratory leaflet contains general preparation advice for several kinds of test, including a section on fasting.

claim: Contributors are required to disclose code-generation tool use in pull request descriptions.
text: Contributor policy: Changes produced with code-generation tools are to be identified in the pull request description before review. Maintainers may ask for reproduction details.

claim: Eli's MRI is still scheduled for 9 August.
text: Radiology update: The 9 August MRI slot was cancelled. Eli is now booked for 12 August at 11:20 a.m.

claim: A pull request requires consensus from the maintainers before merge.
text: Governance charter: Maintainer consensus is required before a pull request can merge. Merge handbook: If consensus is not reached after seven days, a simple majority may authorize the merge.

claim: The clinic made an early-morning slot temporarily available to Noor.
text: From scheduling: I can hold 8:40 a.m. for Noor until noon today; reply before then if that time works. Her existing appointment remains in place meanwhile.

claim: Automation bots are permitted to cast binding governance votes.
text: Meeting workflow: Bots may post agenda summaries and collect links to discussion threads. The designated clerk records every final vote in the minutes.

claim: The clinic cancelled Imani's Tuesday appointment.
text: 09:10 scheduling message: Imani's Tuesday appointment has been cancelled. 11:45 correction: The cancellation entry was made in error; the Tuesday appointment is still active.

claim: Only existing maintainers may open a new RFC.
text: RFC guide: Anyone may open a proposal for community discussion. A maintainer sponsor is required only when the proposal advances to final review.

claim: The clinic booked Priya's ultrasound for 4 May.
text: The clinic received Priya's ultrasound referral and sent it to radiology for review. The note lists the referring practice and clinical question.

claim: The project adopted a requirement for two approving reviewers before a pull request may merge.
text: Accepted governance resolution: A pull request may merge only after approvals from two reviewers with merge rights. The rule takes effect with version 3.2.

claim: Lee accepted the clinic's proposed Friday visit.
text: Clinic: We can move the review to Friday. Lee: Friday is difficult; please leave Tuesday in place unless I call again.

claim: Maintainer appointments in the project last one year.
text: Standing charter: Maintainers serve one-year terms. Transition resolution: The current appointments will remain in force for eighteen months before the first regular election.

claim: A Mandarin interpreter was requested for Sam's consultation.
text: Patient message: Please arrange a Mandarin interpreter for my consultation next week. Reception added the request to the visit notes.

claim: Five voting members constitute quorum for governance meetings.
text: The next governance meeting begins at 16:00 UTC. Agenda items include the roadmap and documentation budget.

claim: The clinic issued Jules a telehealth link.
text: Portal log at 08:05: Telehealth link sent to Jules. Staff note at 08:40: The earlier log entry was incorrect; no link has been issued yet.

claim: Steering committee votes are conducted privately.
text: Meeting rules: Each member's vote is recorded by name in the public minutes. Closed discussion does not make the final vote confidential.

claim: The clinic rescheduled Tessa's visit because her insurer denied coverage.
text: Billing is reviewing Tessa's coverage. In a separate message, a nurse asked which weekdays are convenient if scheduling later needs alternatives.

claim: A release manager may delay a release while a reported vulnerability remains untriaged.
text: Release handbook: A release manager may hold a tag while a reported vulnerability remains untriaged. Once triage is complete, the ordinary release checklist resumes.

claim: Patient transport was confirmed to collect Mira for her appointment.
text: The transport request for Mira was submitted this morning, but dispatch has not accepted it. Scheduling will check again tomorrow.

claim: Confirmed security advisories must be made public immediately.
text: Disclosure policy: Publish an advisory immediately after the issue is confirmed. Embargo procedure: A confirmed issue may remain private for up to fourteen days while a fix is prepared.
